author: partner-desk
title: Inside Vantro's new PayID withdrawal tracker
dek: Vantro now shows every stage of a withdrawal in the app, from request to arrival.
body:
Vantro has introduced a withdrawal tracker that shows each stage of a PayID withdrawal in its app: requested, approved, sent and received. Customers no longer need to contact support to find out where their money is. This partner piece explains how the tracker works and what can slow a withdrawal down.

The four stages

  1. Requested: you ask to withdraw and choose the amount.
  2. Approved: Vantro checks the request, including identity verification if it is your first withdrawal or a new account.
  3. Sent: the payment leaves Vantro through the PayID network.
  4. Received: your bank confirms the funds have arrived.

Each stage shows a time, and the app sends a notification when the money is sent. The tracker also appears in the transaction history, so past withdrawals can be checked later.

Why it matters

Most PayID withdrawals from Vantro arrive within about an hour of the request. When one takes longer, customers want to know why. Vantro says withdrawal questions were the most common reason people contacted its support team, and most of those questions were simply "where is my money?".

The tracker shows where a withdrawal is if it takes longer, for example while identity checks are completed. In that case the "Approved" step shows what is needed, such as a photo of a driver licence, with a button to upload it.

What can slow a withdrawal

ReasonWhat to do
First withdrawal, identity not yet verifiedUpload ID in the app; checks usually take minutes
Bank account name does not match the Vantro accountWithdraw to an account in your own name
Bank holds the payment for its own checksContact your bank; Vantro's tracker shows it as sent
Withdrawal requested late at nightSome checks run in business hours

Cancelling a withdrawal

Vantro does not allow customers to reverse a withdrawal once it has been requested and returned to their betting balance. The company says this is deliberate: reversing a withdrawal to keep betting is a common sign of chasing losses, and removing the option is one of its safer-betting measures.

Other payment information

Deposits to Vantro can be made by debit card, PayID or BPAY. Credit cards and digital currency cannot be used, in line with the national ban on credit card betting. Deposit limits can be set or lowered at any time and apply immediately when lowered.

The takeaway

If you bet with Vantro, the tracker gives you a clear view of every withdrawal. Verify your identity before you need to withdraw, and make sure your bank account is in your own name to avoid delays.

Gambling is not a way to make money. Set a limit you are comfortable with, and if you need support, contact Gambling Help Online on 1800 858 858. 18+ only.
